name: Robinson Rancheria of Pomo Indians (United States)
description: A blue field with a red horizontal band across the centre, crossed by a diagonal band of small triangles — white on the blue and orange on the red — descending from the upper hoist to the lower fly, in a Pomo basketry pattern.
history: Flag of the Robinson Rancheria of Pomo Indians of California.

features.role: diagonal band of small triangles (basketry pattern)
